description: This Java source file defines a class 'ContentType' that provides constants and methods related to MIME content types used in multimedia messaging services (MMS). The class includes lists of supported content, image, audio, and video types, as well as utility methods to check if a content type is supported or belongs to a specific category.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: A utility class that manages MIME content types for multimedia messaging, including supported types and categorization functions.

methods.name: isSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if the given content type is supported.

methods.name: isSupportedImageType
methods.description: Checks if the given content type is a supported image type.

methods.name: isSupportedAudioType
methods.description: Checks if the given content type is a supported audio type.

methods.name: isSupportedVideoType
methods.description: Checks if the given content type is a supported video type.

methods.name: isTextType
methods.description: Determines if the content type is a text type.

methods.name: isImageType
methods.description: Determines if the content type is an image type.

methods.name: isAudioType
methods.description: Determines if the content type is an audio type.

methods.name: isVideoType
methods.description: Determines if the content type is a video type.

methods.name: isDrmType
methods.description: Checks if the content type is a DRM type.

methods.name: isUnspecified
methods.description: Checks if the content type is a wildcard/unspecified type.

methods.name: getImageTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported image MIME types.

methods.name: getAudioTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported audio MIME types.

methods.name: getVideoTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported video MIME types.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported content MIME types.
